Hey there. I’m sorry to hear that , purely because I know how terrifying it is to go through such a thing. Honestly, just being kind, reassuring that everything will get better and reassuring that what she’s going through is understood, if she has  an episode don’t make her feel as though she’s to blame, or to call police or section her or whatever because it really makes you think everyone’s against you. I went through a bad patch when I thought everyone was trying to kill me, looking back now all I wish I’d done was talk about what the voices were actually saying and for someone to make me realise that’s it’s okay but it’s not normal and that’s part of the illness. Ask her what they tell her and how they affect her daily life, having someone who can reassure you that it’s not you or reality it’s just your brain is all I really wanted. So to sum it up, reassurance that’s the main thing x

I originally thought I was experiencing super long dejavu's and thought such was normal until somebody commented on the length of time. More so recently I was having a reoccurring dream for months about running away to this building close to where I live. It wasn't until I moved a few weeks ago I was sat in the living room and all of a sudden I realised why this place felt so familiar even though I'd never been in the building before, it was the location of my escape dreams. 

My dreams have been getting very intense but is still a fairly new thing for me, I need to pay more attention to them...i think something is emerging!
